en.colorHint: App color themes (native light/dark; recolors, not relayouts)
en.dialogAlphaHint: 0 = conversation fully transparent, 1 = solid; settings/sidebar stay solid (independent). Drag to preview only; applied on "Apply".
en.importHint: Stored into the plugin assets/, persists across restarts.
en.maskHint: Dims the backdrop (only affects the background, not text); drag to preview only, applied on "Apply".
en.modeFollowHint: Move the mouse left/right to orbit the video frames (smooth lerp, no jumps).
en.modeLoopHint: Autoplay looping video as the background.
en.noImage: No image imported yet u2014 import one below.
en.sectionDesc: Change the DSH web GUI background: built-in themes / image / video (orbit-follow or loop).
en.themeAlphaHint: 0 = panels fully transparent (background shows), 1 = solid; bubbles/cards follow. Drag to preview only; applied on "Apply".
